The given operator is a second-order differential operator of the form

$$
D(y)={f}_{2}(x,y)\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}+{f}_{1}(x,y)\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+{f}_{0}(x,y)y
$$

with ${f}_{2}=y,{f}_{1}=0,$ and ${f}_{0}=4y.$

To compute $D(y),$ we apply the definition of the operator $D$ to the function $y=\operatorname{cos}⁡2x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}D(\operatorname{cos}⁡2x) & =\operatorname{cos}⁡2x\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}(\operatorname{cos}⁡2x)+4{(\operatorname{cos}⁡2x)}^{2} \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡2x\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-2\operatorname{sin}⁡2x)+4{cos}^{2}⁡2x \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡2x(-4\operatorname{cos}⁡2x)+4{cos}^{2}⁡2x \\  & =-4{cos}^{2}⁡2x+4{cos}^{2}⁡2x \\  & =0\end{aligned}
$$
